name: TGI batch forward-duration histogram (prefill/decode split)
notes: TGI main, router/src/server.rs plus backends/v3/src/{backend,queue,lib}.rs, read 2026-10-04. On by default: the Prometheus recorder is built unconditionally with PrometheusBuilder and an HTTP listener on prometheus_port, default 9000, so nothing has to be opted into. Label keys are method (prefill|decode) on the batch families, err on tgi_request_failure, and reason on tgi_batch_concat - there are no model or engine labels, so every series is fleet-wide. method in {prefill, decode}. This label is the reason TGI is worth knowing about: it is the only engine here that lets you compare prefill and decode batch cost directly as two series of one metric, rather than reconstructing the split from separate metric names.
